panels.title: WebSocket Connected
panels.description: Streaming market-data provider connection status per provider (0 = disconnected / red, 1 = connected / green). Source: `hg_websocket_connected{provider}` from `LiveDataProvider.is_connected()`. Meaningful only during market hours -- outside hours, streaming is idle and this gauge reflects the last state before disconnect.

panels.title: Broker Heartbeat Age (s)
panels.description: Seconds since the last successful broker API call per broker. Computed as `time() - hg_broker_last_heartbeat_timestamp{broker}`. Each successful `broker.get_account()` etc. stamps the gauge. Green < 60s, yellow 60-300s, red > 300s. Useful for detecting broker outages or stuck strategy processes.

panels.title: Order Rejection Rate (5m)
panels.description: Per-second rate of order rejections over a 5-minute rolling window, from `rate(hg_orders_rejected_total[5m])`. A flat zero line is healthy -- non-zero means a broker is rejecting orders (check Incident Review dashboard for `reason` label breakdown). `noValue: 0` makes the panel render a flat line even when no rejections have occurred yet, so 'no data' does not look identical to 'healthy'.

panels.title: Process RSS by Strategy
panels.description: Resident memory (bytes) per strategy Python process. Source: `hg_process_rss_bytes{strategy}` -- each sidecar reads its own `/proc/self/status`. Stable flat lines are normal. Slow monotonic growth over days = potential leak. Sudden drops followed by a restart = OOM kill (check MemoryMax in the systemd unit).

panels.title: RAMP Cache Age (s)
panels.description: Seconds since RAMP's historical-bars pickle was last refreshed. Source: `hg_ramp_cache_age_seconds` = `time() - getmtime(~/.homeguard/cache/ramp_historical_cache_YYYYMMDD.pkl)`. RAMP refreshes this cache once per trading day on first tick after market open, so a monotonic climb from 0 -> 24h IS EXPECTED overnight. Green < 24h (normal within/across session), yellow 24-48h (missed a session), red > 48h (stale -- RAMP isn't refreshing).
